mapper.sql: select k.knowledge_base_id, k.knowledge_base_code, k.knowledge_base_name, k.brand_id, b.brand_name, k.model_id, m.model_name, k.description, k.sort_order, k.status, k.del_flag, k.create_by, k.create_time, k.update_by, k.update_time, k.remark from oc_knowledge_base k left join oc_brand b on b.brand_id = k.brand_id left join oc_product_model m on m.model_id = k.model_id
mapper.select: where k.del_flag = '0' and k.status = '0' and b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = '0' and m.del_flag = '0' and m.status = '0' order by k.sort_order, k.knowledge_base_id

where k.model_id = #{modelId} and k.del_flag = '0' and k.status = '0' and b.del_flag = '0' and b.status = '0' and m.del_flag = '0' and m.status = '0' order by k.sort_order, k.knowledge_base_id limit 1
select count(1) from oc_knowledge_base where del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from oc_knowledge_base where model_id = #{modelId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update oc_knowledge_base set knowledge_base_code = #{knowledgeBaseCode}, knowledge_base_name = #{knowledgeBaseName}, brand_id = #{brandId}, model_id = #{modelId}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} and del_flag = '0'
